title: Zesty Smoky Spanish Potato Tortilla Espanola
description: A smoky and flaky Spanish dish featuring white chocolate chips, this ovo-vegetarian friendly tortilla is perfect for any meal, with a unique blend of smoke and heat, and a surprising sweetness from the white chocolate.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the sliced potatoes and onions with smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and cook the potato and onion mixture until they are tender and lightly browned.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
In a large bowl, whisk the eggs and stir in the white chocolate chips.
Add the cooked potato and onion mixture to the bowl with the eggs and stir until everything is well combined.
Pour the mixture into a greased 9 inch round baking dish.
Bake the tortilla for 35 minutes or until the eggs are set and the tortilla is golden brown.
Remove the tortilla from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
